Use case: ui-mockup. ONE COMPLETE finished 3200x1440, 20:9 mobile landscape game screenshot. The requested visual direction is DARK GOTHIC + OCCULT CULT HORROR, with Darkest Dungeon as the dominant art reference. This is a deliberate new art direction, not a recolor of a luminous blue fantasy UI.
You must generate the ENTIRE finished picture: the complete interface design, composition, Chinese typography, tabs, item icons, panels, buttons, character art and environment. No later UI overlay is planned. Deliver something with the authored identity and quality of a premium Steam indie game, not a wireframe, stock fantasy template, website dashboard or separate background.
REFERENCES: Images 1, 2 and 3 are actual Darkest Dungeon screenshots, respectively combat, provision merchant and character information. They are the dominant visual style references: coarse black contour, deep ink shadow masses, angular hand-rendered hatching, carved/cut silhouettes, severe sacred architecture, dry bone accents, psychologically uncomfortable characters, controlled detail and spacious black GUI surfaces. Absorb their art direction but create original characters, symbols, architecture and UI for our game. Do not copy their words, game systems, currency, party or exact proprietary assets. Image 4 is OUR actual bare battle scene, authority for our oblique battle, knight identity, three red-robed enemies and room structure; it is not the UI style reference.
THE STYLE IS GOTHIC. THE MOOD IS CULT. A fallen monastery that has become an obscure sect's sanctuary: oppressive pointed arches, heavy stone, iron reliquary work, weathered devotional reliefs, ash-dusted linen, torn liturgical banners, dripped wax, one original unsettling cult sigil. Ritual objects and a few candles imply worship gone wrong. The horror comes from severe shape, silence, shadow, ritual hierarchy and uneasy human expression—not from gore, random skull piles or dozens of pentagrams.
PALETTE AND MARK-MAKING: broad carbon-black/charcoal masses, aged parchment and bone, iron-grey, dried oxblood red, tiny dull brass and occasional restrained desaturated sick-green item accents. Deep shadows should be almost ink-flat, with selective hard-edged reflected candle light. No dominant electric blue/cyan, purple neon, brilliant gold, magic-shop glow, glossy metal bevels, bloom, lens flares, saturated jewel effects or decorative symmetry. UI and illustration must share a tactile, slightly irregular, deliberate hand-authored quality. Make it rich through composition and sculpted shadow, not through indiscriminate filigree.
Retain a deliberate PIXEL-ART game finish: crisp clustered pixel shapes and readable small sprites; interpret the rough Darkest Dungeon drawing into a pixel-compatible visual language. Neither photorealism nor generic 3D render. Don't turn the scene into a soft oil painting. Type should be beautifully designed and sharply legible in Chinese, with a severe gothic editorial character in titles and calm readable body text. No English slogans or fake microtext.
MOBILE: large finger-friendly important actions, bold clear selected state, generously readable key information. Design proportions freely within our functional relationships. Sparse meaningful art marks around selected elements, broad clean reading surfaces, muted empty slots. Do not shrink everything to fit a PC dashboard.
FUNCTION: three global tabs “装备栏位 / 英雄属性 / 装备图鉴”. Left equipped build; central scene or task; distinct right backpack exactly two base cells wide extending vertically. Actual equipped items each occupy ONE merged full-width block spanning the two cells, with no middle vertical seam. Empty rows may show the two underlying cells. The three equipped items in vertical order: “凝血毒剂” (green vial), “灵魂香菇” (pale sick-green mushroom), “淬毒利刃” (silver dagger, muted brass hilt). Generate detailed but sharply readable ORIGINAL icons in this occult ink-and-pixel language. No cute toy icons or glossy jewels. Only the dagger shows an EMPTY charge strip “0 / 100”. Do not invent flavor text for the equipment cards; the names and images are sufficient.
Top status only: “生命 180 / 180”, “体力 100 / 100”, “腐化 0 / 100”, “金币 4”. Health is full muted crimson, stamina full desaturated green/steel-teal, corruption track EMPTY at zero. A single original ritual medallion can anchor this status area. No invented mini-map, capacity counts, combat commands, extra resources or duplicated navigation.
No new mechanics, no crafting/enchanting/forging services, no extra global tabs, no game logo/title, no PC/controller hints, no phone frame. All words are rendered by the image model as part of the finished art.

SCREEN 1: FULL COMBAT HUD, equipment tab selected.
Honor reference4's exact oblique battle identity, the recognizable room footprint and terrain, the white/bone-and-brass helmeted knight and THREE red-robed enemies. Keep all four actors visible. Do not turn this into Darkest Dungeon's four-heroes side-view lineup or a platformer. The existing world may be relit and stylistically interpreted with dark ink, ash-stone and ominous ritual candlelight while retaining its geometry and subjects.
The central combat space must dominate and remain readable. Reimagine the surrounding interface as spare, severe relic cases and charcoal inventory ledgers with tasteful worn bone/copper ruling and an oxblood selected accent, avoiding bulky gothic furniture covering the action. Give the three equipment icons unmistakable crafted silhouettes; right backpack is empty. The frame/world can suggest an abandoned sect crypt through a few hanging seal-ribbons and iron votive shapes at the edges, never fake extra interactive tools.
Location label “遗迹”; concise bottom instruction “按住瞄准 · 松手弹射”. Read-only equipment while combat is active. NO sell/reorder/upgrade buttons. Make it visually arresting, restrained and ominous. A high-end original game screenshot whose Gothic cult identity is visible in the SHAPES and SHADOWS as much as its palette.
